analysis.title: GS Milhous - CAS Mark to Market for Friday 16 Oct 2026
key_insights: US equities fell on Friday 10/16 with continued weakness in AI-linked names: SPX -109bps to 7659, NDX -250bps to 29,187, RTY -166bps to 2721. Indices faded into the close and finished just off the worst levels.

Info Tech (-254bps) and Communication Services (-245bps) were the largest sector laggards, though 6 sectors still gained. Global Neoclouds (GSXGNEOC) fell 902bps, extending losses amid renewed focus on AI funding and debt.
Energy rose 246bps, led by Nat Gas stocks (GSENNATG +395bps, a 2.8 sigma move).
The US curve steepened as the front end outperformed and caught a bid while equities slid. 2s10s and 2s30s both closed 5bps steeper.
Swap spreads were hit after the primary dealer questionnaire did not give a strong indication of a reduction in long-end auction sizes.

Markets close the week pricing about 4.75bps of Fed hikes at the October meeting and about 25bps of hikes through year-end. Next week is a lighter data week with no Fedspeak because of the blackout period. Supply includes a 20y bond and a 5y TIPS auction.
Macro credit weakened into the weekend: CDX IG closed 1.66bps wider and CDX HY 37 cents lower, in decompressionary flows. Itraxx was strong overnight, but the tone soured later in the session.
Idiosyncratic credit names CRWV and FMC were down several points. Longer-dated ORCL bonds were about 40bps wider, and IG TMT showed volatile dispersion in spreads and beta.
Vol agendas were to sell intermediate-dated HY vol and to sell IG downside tails going out. In primary markets, $8bn priced across 1 IG deal and no HY deals priced.

The dollar was soft against G10 peers. Most long-dollar positioning is held by models/CTAs and by those hedging another underlying asset, which makes finding the pain point of the dollar decline harder because their reaction function differs from discretionary investors.

EUR rose 15bps to close back above 1.12 and was up 50bps on the week after a 100bps drop early in the week. USDJPY ended flat, tracking yields, which made JPY the worst performer against USD on the day.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Market-implied pricing for a hike at the October meeting is small.
Markets price about 25bps of cumulative hikes by year-end.

risk_factors: Renewed focus on AI funding and debt is pressuring Global Neoclouds and related credit, including CRWV.

Primary dealer questionnaire gave no strong signal of lower long-end auction sizes, which weighed on swap spreads.
vol_and_positioning: VIX rose 3.53 to 19.99, with a notable climb in the afternoon.
Credit vol agendas were to sell intermediate-dated HY vol and IG downside tails going out.
Most long-dollar positioning is held by models/CTAs and by those hedging another underlying asset, which complicates pain-point targeting for the dollar move lower.
